Special Vehicle Towing in Calgary | BP Towing – Expert Transport for Luxury, Exotic & Oversized Vehicles

Some vehicles are different. A low-slung exotic car can't be pulled onto a standard wheel-lift truck. A lifted pickup with oversized tires won't fit in a normal flatbed. A classic car with fragile paint and irreplaceable parts needs white-glove handling. A luxury SUV with air suspension requires special care during loading.

Schedule Your Service 24/7 Emergency Service Call
Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing

Special Vehicle Towing Designed for Unique Situations

Standard towing works for standard vehicles. But when your vehicle is valuable, rare, modified, or just plain different, you need a towing company that understands the risks. Our team is trained in vehicle-specific towing techniques, using the right equipment for each unique situation.

Common special vehicle towing situations we handle:

  • Exotic car transport – Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche, McLaren, Aston Martin

  • Luxury vehicle towing – Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Lexus, Jaguar, Genesis

  • Classic and collector car transport – Restored muscle cars, vintage European cars, hot rods

  • Lifted trucks and SUVs – Oversized tires, modified suspension, extra height and width

  • Lowered vehicles – Custom suspensions, body kits, front lips, side skirts

  • Oversized vehicles – Large SUVs (Suburban, Expedition, Escalade ESV), full-size vans

  • Track-day and race car transport – No plates, no insurance, race slicks, low clearance

  • High-value vehicles – Six-figure cars that owners won't trust to just anyone

  • Vehicles with active aerodynamics – Rear wings, front splitters, carbon fiber parts

  • Electric and hybrid luxury vehicles – Tesla, Lucid, Rivian, Porsche Taycan

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What Makes BP Towing Different for
Special Vehicle Towing in Calgary

Not every towing company should touch a special vehicle. Some use worn-out flatbeds, dirty straps, or inexperienced drivers. We take a different approach – one built on care, precision, and respect for your investment.

Experienced operators

Our drivers are trained in specialty vehicle handling: proper loading angles, chassis grounding, air suspension override, and damage-free tie-downs. No one learns on your car.

Specialized equipment

We use extended flatbeds for long vehicles, low-angle ramps for lowered cars, soft straps with padding, and multiple tie-down points. Nothing touches your paint or carbon fiber.

Damage-free transport methods

We never hook to control arms, subframes, or plastic trim. We use manufacturer-approved recovery points or secure structural components with padded straps.

Fully insured service

We carry high-limit liability and cargo insurance specifically for high-value vehicles. In the unlikely event of damage, you're fully covered.

Upfront pricing

We tell you the cost before we dispatch. No hidden fees, no "exotic car surcharge" surprises. Transparent, honest pricing.

White-glove communication

We call you before dispatch, update you on ETA, and walk you through the loading process. No surprises.

Types of Special Vehicles We Tow

CategoryExamplesSpecial Considerations
Exotic carsFerrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Aston Martin, Ford GTLow clearance, wide body, carbon fiber, active aero
Luxury sedans/SUVsS-Class, 7 Series, A8, Range Rover, Cayenne, G-WagenAir suspension (must be disabled), sensitive electronics
Classic cars1960s Mustang, Porsche 911 (air-cooled), Jaguar E-TypeFragile paint, irreplaceable parts, odd anchor points
Lifted trucksRam 2500 on 37s, F-250 lifted, Toyota Tundra on 35sExtra height, wide tires, heavy weight, high center of gravity
Lowered carsStanced imports, bagged suspension, track-ready carsScrape risk on ramps, low front lips, side skirts
Oversized SUVs/vansSuburban, Expedition Max, Sprinter, Promaster, TransitExtra length, extra weight, need extended flatbed
Track/race carsPorsche GT3, BMW M4 GT4, Radical, spec MiataNo plates, no insurance, race slicks, low nose
Electric luxuryTesla Model S Plaid, Lucid Air, Rivian R1T, Taycan TurboBattery weight, jack point requirements, tow mode activation

Service Areas for Special Vehicle Towing in Calgary

BP Towing Calgary provides special vehicle towing across Calgary and a 30‑km radius. We regularly respond to:

Downtown Calgary, Beltline, Inglewood, Bridgeland, Mission, Kensington, Hillhurst, Brentwood, Dalhousie, Varsity, Edgemont, Huntington Hills, Marlborough, Forest Lawn, Dover, Ogden, Sundance, Midnapore, Evergreen, Bridlewood, Signal Hill, Aspen Woods, Rocky Ridge, Royal Oak, Panorama Hills, Coventry Hills, and all neighbouring communities.

We also serve major roadways including Deerfoot Trail, Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Stoney Trail, Macleod Trail, plus nearby towns (Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks).

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

How Special Vehicle Towing Works

    1. Call or text BP Towing – Tell us your vehicle type, location, and situation. Be specific: "2021 Lamborghini Huracan" not just "sports car."

    2. We ask detailed questions – Ground clearance? Air suspension? Modifications? Running or not running? Keys available? This ensures we bring the right equipment.

    3. We dispatch the right truck – Extended flatbed for long vehicles. Low-angle ramps for lowered cars. Extra straps for heavy trucks.

    4. We arrive and assess – We inspect your vehicle together (if possible) and document existing condition. We confirm the loading plan with you.

    5. We load with extreme care – Slow, controlled loading. Wood blocks or low ramps for clearance. Soft straps on approved anchor points. No rushing.

    6. We secure and transport – Multiple straps, checked and rechecked. Gentle driving – no hard braking or aggressive corners.

    7. We unload at destination – Same careful process in reverse. You inspect the vehicle before we leave.

Get a free, no‑obligation special vehicle towing quote in under 60 seconds. Call or text now.

Save our number in your phone today. When your exotic, classic, or special vehicle needs a tow, you'll know exactly who to call – and we'll treat it like our own.

(403) 991-2265

Stop waiting!

Contact BP Towing for Special Vehicle Towing in Calgary

Your special vehicle is an investment. Trust it to a team that treats it that way. Call or text BP Towing – we answer live 24 hours a day.

FAQS

Frequently Asked Questions

How fast will a special vehicle tow truck arrive?

In most Calgary neighbourhoods, expect 20 to 35 minutes. We prioritize special vehicle calls and may send our most experienced driver. We text you a live ETA.

Do you tow exotic cars like Ferraris or Lamborghinis?

Yes – we have experience towing all major exotic brands. We use low-angle ramps, soft straps, and extra care. Call us with the exact model so we can prepare.

Can you tow a lowered car without damaging the front lip?

Yes – we carry low-angle ramps, wood blocks, and can sometimes winch the car onto the flatbed using a bridle. Tell us your ground clearance when you call.

What about air suspension vehicles?

We know how to disable air suspension (where possible) or use ramps to avoid over-extension. For some vehicles, we may need to activate “transport mode” – have your owner’s manual ready or call your dealer.

Do you tow race cars without license plates or insurance?

Yes – we transport track cars, race cars, and project cars that are not road-legal. You are responsible for any permits or requirements. We just tow.

Can you tow a lifted truck with oversized tires?

Yes – but we need to know the height and width. Some lifted trucks exceed our flatbed capacity. Call us with details – we may accept the job or refer you to a heavy-duty tower.

Motorcycle Towing in Calgary | BP Towing – Safe, Secure Transport for Your Bike

Your motorcycle breaks down on Deerfoot Trail. Or you lay it down on a slippery Calgary corner. Or you bought a bike that doesn't run and need it brought home. Or you're heading out of town for the season and need your motorcycle transported to storage.

Schedule Your Service 24/7 Emergency Service Call
Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing

Motorcycle Towing Designed for Real-Life Situations

Motorcycles aren't cars. They're lighter, more fragile, and easier to damage during towing. A standard tow truck hooking to a bike's frame can bend it. Improper strapping can crush fairings or scratch paint. Our team understands these risks and uses specialized equipment designed specifically for motorcycles.

Common motorcycle towing situations we handle:

  • Breakdown towing – Mechanical failure, electrical issues, or a dead battery

  • Accident recovery – You laid the bike down or were involved in a collision

  • Non-running bike transport – You bought a project bike or your bike won't start

  • Seasonal storage transport – Moving your bike to or from winter storage

  • Long-distance transport – Across Calgary or to nearby towns

  • Shop delivery – Taking your bike to a mechanic for repairs or maintenance

  • Home delivery – You broke down and need the bike brought to your garage

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What Makes BP Towing Different for
Motorcycle Towing in Calgary

Not every towing company should tow a motorcycle. Some use flatbeds designed for cars, with straps meant for 4,000‑pound vehicles. We take a different approach.

Experienced motorcycle operators

Our drivers are trained in motorcycle-specific towing: proper anchor points, correct strap tension, fairing protection, and balanced loading. No one learns on your bike.

Specialized equipment

We use soft straps, canyon dancers (handlebar straps), wheel chocks, and padded tie-downs designed for motorcycles. No hooks on painted frames.

Flatbed towing only

We never tow a motorcycle with a wheel‑lift or dolly. Every bike goes on a flatbed with all wheels off the ground. Zero risk of drivetrain or suspension damage.

Fairing and paint protection

We use soft ties and padding anywhere a strap touches your bike. No scratches, no gouges, no rubbed-through paint.

Upfront pricing

We tell you the cost before we dispatch. No hidden fees, no "motorcycle surcharge" surprises.

24/7 availability

Nights, weekends, holidays, and Calgary's worst weather – we never close.

Types of Motorcycles We Tow

TypeExamplesSpecial Considerations
Sport bikesYamaha R-series, Kawasaki Ninja, Honda CBR, Suzuki GSX-RLow fairings, need careful strap placement
CruisersHarley-Davidson, Indian, Honda Rebel, Yamaha V-StarHeavy, need wide wheel chocks
Touring bikesHarley Electra Glide, Honda Gold Wing, BMW K1600Very heavy (800–1,000 lbs), extra secure tie-downs
Dual sport / ADVBMW GS, KTM Adventure, Suzuki V-StromTall suspension, requires taller wheel chock
Standard / nakedYamaha MT, Honda CB, Suzuki SVNo fairings to protect, but exposed frame
Dirt bikesHonda CRF, Yamaha YZ, KTM SXLightweight, may be transported in a truck bed
Scooters / mopedsVespa, Honda Ruckus, Yamaha ZumaSmall, need careful balancing
Custom / chopperAny custom buildUnusual frame geometry requires custom strapping

Service Areas for Motorcycle Towing in Calgary

BP Towing provides motorcycle towing across Calgary and a 30‑km radius. We regularly respond to:

Downtown Calgary, Beltline, Inglewood, Bridgeland, Mission, Kensington, Hillhurst, Brentwood, Dalhousie, Varsity, Edgemont, Huntington Hills, Marlborough, Forest Lawn, Dover, Ogden, Sundance, Midnapore, Evergreen, Bridlewood, Signal Hill, Aspen Woods, Rocky Ridge, Royal Oak, Panorama Hills, Coventry Hills, and all neighbouring communities.

We also serve major roadways including Deerfoot Trail (Highway 2), Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Stoney Trail, Macleod Trail, Sarcee Trail, Highway 1 (Trans‑Canada), Highway 8, and Highway 22X, plus nearby towns (Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks).

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

How Motorcycle Towing Works

    1. Call or text BP Towing – Tell us your location, bike type, and situation (breakdown, accident, transport).

    2. We dispatch a flatbed truck – Our truck arrives with motorcycle-specific equipment.

    3. We assess your bike – We check for existing damage (we document it), anchor points, and the best loading method.

    4. We load carefully – The bike is rolled or winched onto the flatbed, secured in a wheel chock, and strapped down at multiple points.

    5. We transport safely – Your bike travels fully secured, with straps checked en route.

    6. We unload at destination – Your bike is rolled off carefully at your preferred location (home, shop, storage).

Get a free, no‑obligation motorcycle towing quote in under 60 seconds. Call or text now.

Save our number in your phone today. When your bike breaks down, you'll know exactly who to call – and we'll treat it like our own.

(403) 991-2265

Stop waiting!

Contact BP Towing for Motorcycle Towing in Calgary

Your bike is your passion. Let us treat it that way. Call or text BP Towing – we answer live 24 hours a day.

FAQS

Frequently Asked Questions

How fast will a motorcycle tow truck arrive?

In most Calgary neighbourhoods and along major roadways, expect 20 to 35 minutes. During heavy snow, extreme cold, or rush hour, allow up to 45 minutes. We text you a live ETA once the technician is en route.

Do you tow motorcycles with a wheel‑lift or dolly?

No – we use flatbed trucks only. Wheel‑lifts can damage motorcycle frames, suspension, and fairings. Your bike goes on a flatbed with all wheels off the ground.

Can you tow a motorcycle that has been in an accident?

Yes – we recover accident-damaged bikes. We assess the damage and use extra care when loading. If the front wheel is damaged, we may use a winch and special straps.

Do you tow motorcycles with custom or aftermarket parts?

Yes – but tell us about any modifications (extended swingarms, lowered suspension, custom fairings, etc.) so we can adjust our strapping method.

Can you tow a motorcycle from an underground parkade?

Yes – provided the parkade has sufficient clearance (at least 1.8 metres / 6 feet) and safe access for our flatbed. Call us with your location details.

What if my motorcycle doesn't have a key or the steering is locked?

We can still tow it. A locked steering column requires extra care when loading and strapping. Tell our dispatcher when you call.

Do you tow motorcycles with a wheel‑lift or dolly?

We can still tow it. A locked steering column requires extra care when loading and strapping. Tell our dispatcher when you call.

Sometimes you need something moved, but it won't fit in your car. Maybe it's a load of construction materials for a job site. Maybe it's furniture, appliances, or renovation debris. Maybe you need equipment moved from one location to another across Calgary. That's where BP Towing comes in.

Schedule Your Service 24/7 Emergency Service Call

Local Hauling Designed for Real-Life Hauling Needs

You might think of BP Towing as just a towing company. But our trucks and trailers are also perfect for local hauling jobs. Whether you're a contractor needing materials delivered to a job site, a homeowner clearing out a garage, or a business moving equipment across town – we can help.

Common local hauling situations we handle:

  • Construction materials – Lumber, drywall, roofing supplies, concrete bags, rebar

  • Landscaping supplies – Soil, mulch, gravel, sod, pavers, retaining wall blocks

  • Furniture and appliances – Couches, mattresses, refrigerators, washers, dryers, freezers

  • Renovation debris – Old cabinets, drywall scraps, flooring, bathroom fixtures

  • Equipment transport – Lawn mowers, snow blowers, power tools, air compressors, generators

  • Business inventory – Boxes, pallets, retail displays, office furniture

  • Recycling and donation drop-offs – Items going to the dump, recycling centre, or charity

  • Market and event supplies – Tents, tables, chairs, booth materials for farmers markets or craft fairs

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What Makes BP Towing Different for
Local Hauling in Calgary

You could rent a truck. But then you have to pick it up, fuel it, load it, drive it, unload it, return it, and pay for mileage. Or you could call BP Towing. We bring the truck. We do the driving. You focus on other things.

Experienced operators

Our drivers know how to secure different types of loads: lumber, appliances, loose items, fragile materials. No shifting cargo. No damage in transit.

Well-maintained fleet

Our trucks and trailers are regularly inspected and maintained. We don't send unreliable vehicles. Your hauling job arrives safely.

Fully insured service

We carry commercial liability and cargo insurance. If something happens in transit (rare, but possible), you're protected.

Same-day service

Need something moved today? Call us. For most local hauling requests, we can dispatch a truck within hours.

Affordable rates

No hidden fees, no mileage charges, no fuel surcharges. Transparent, upfront pricing based on the job.

Professional customer support

Real people answer the phone. No automated menus, no call centres. Tell us what you need hauled, and we'll make it happen.

What We Haul (and What We Don't)

Yes, we haul these items:

CategoryExamples
Building materialsLumber, drywall, plywood, roofing, concrete, insulation
Landscaping suppliesSoil, mulch, gravel, sand, sod, pavers, stones
FurnitureSofas, tables, chairs, desks, bookcases, dressers, bed frames
AppliancesWashers, dryers, refrigerators, freezers, stoves, dishwashers
EquipmentLawn mowers, snow blowers, generators, power tools, compressors
DebrisRenovation waste, old flooring, drywall scraps, broken furniture
Business goodsBoxes, pallets, inventory, displays, office furniture
Donation itemsFurniture, appliances, household goods for charities

We do NOT haul these items (call us to confirm – exceptions possible):

  • Hazardous materials (chemicals, paints, solvents, batteries, propane tanks)

  • Flammable or explosive items

  • Biohazards or medical waste

  • Extremely heavy industrial machinery (over 5,000 lbs – ask us)

  • Large volumes of loose trash (contact a bin rental company)

  • Live animals or perishable food

If you're unsure whether we can haul your item, call us. We'll give you a straight answer.

We also serve nearby towns including Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, and Okotoks for local hauling within those areas (or transport between Calgary and these towns).

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

How Local Hauling Works

  1. Call or text BP Towing – Tell us what you need hauled: what items, from where, to where, and when.

  2. Get a free quote – We provide upfront pricing based on the job. No surprises.

  3. Schedule your haul – Same-day or future appointment. We work around your timeline.

  4. We arrive with the right truck – We assess the load and use the appropriate vehicle (flatbed, box truck, or trailer with tie-downs).

  5. We load and secure – Our operators do the heavy lifting (within reason). We strap, tarp, and protect your items.

  6. We transport safely – Your items travel securely to the destination.

  7. We unload (optional) – We can drop items curbside, in a driveway, or inside a garage. Extra fees may apply for inside delivery.

You don't lift a finger (unless you want to).

How much does local hauling cost in Calgary?

We provide upfront pricing based on the job: size/weight of items, distance, loading/unloading requirements, and time. Call us for a free, no‑obligation quote. No hidden fees.

Do you offer same-day hauling?

Yes – for most local hauling requests, we can dispatch a truck within hours. Call us as early as possible to secure a same-day slot.

Do I need to help load or unload?

No – our operators handle loading and securing. For very heavy or bulky items, we may ask for your assistance or recommend additional labour. We’ll discuss this when you book.

Can you haul items from a second-floor apartment?

We can pick up items from ground level or a garage. For upstairs apartments without an elevator, we may need to discuss logistics. We are not a moving company – we transport items that are already ready to go.

Do you haul junk or trash to the dump?

Yes – we can haul renovation debris, old furniture, appliances, and general junk to the landfill or recycling centre. Call us with a description of your items for a quote.

Can you transport a hot tub or large safe?

Possibly – but these are heavy and require special equipment. Call us with dimensions and weight. We may accept the job or refer you to a specialist.

Winch Out Service in Calgary | BP Towing – Stuck? We Pull You Out

You turn the wheel. You press the gas. The engine revs, but you don't move. Your wheels spin. You're stuck. Maybe it's snow. Maybe it's ice, mud, sand, or a soft shoulder. Maybe you slid off the road on a slippery Calgary winter night. Maybe you parked on what looked like solid ground, but spring melt turned it into a mud pit.

Schedule Your Service 24/7 Emergency Service Call
Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing

Winch Out Service Designed for Real-Life Situations

Getting stuck is embarrassing, but it happens to almost every Calgary driver at some point. Our winters are long, our spring thaws are messy, and our roads have soft shoulders that can swallow a tire in seconds. BP Towing doesn't judge – we just pull you out.

Common stuck situations we handle:

  • Stuck in snow – A residential street after a blizzard, an unplowed alley, or your own driveway

  • Stuck on ice – Black ice on a side street or a frozen parking lot

  • Stuck in mud – Spring or summer after heavy rain, on a rural road or job site

  • Stuck in sand or gravel – Soft shoulders on country roads or construction areas

  • Stuck in a ditch – You slid off the road on Deerfoot, Stoney, or a highway

  • Stuck in a snowbank – You misjudged the edge of the plowed road

  • Stuck in a field or off-road area – You took a wrong turn or went exploring

  • Stuck in a low-clearance situation – High-centred on a speed bump, curb, or rock

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What Makes BP Towing Different for Winch-
Out in Calgary

You might ask a friend with a truck to pull you out. But a yank with a tow strap can rip off your bumper, damage your frame, or snap the strap and send metal flying. Our professional winch-out service uses controlled techniques, proper anchors, and careful equipment placement.

Fast response times

Our winch-equipped trucks are positioned across Calgary. Most winch-out calls receive a 25- to 45-minute arrival time, depending on your location and how far off the road you are.

Certified technicians

Every team member is trained in winching techniques: proper anchor points, winch line tension, angle pulls, and vehicle protection. No cowboy pulls.

Modern winching equipment

We use professional-grade winches with synthetic or steel lines, snatch blocks for directional pulls, and soft straps that won't damage your vehicle's frame or suspension.

Damage-free recovery

We attach to manufacturer-approved recovery points or secure structural components. No hooking to control arms, axles, or plastic bumpers.

Upfront pricing

We tell you the cost before we dispatch. No hidden fees, no "extraction" surprises, no after‑hour markups. Simple, honest winch-out pricing.

24/7 availability

Nights, weekends, Christmas Day, Canada Day – we never close. Getting stuck doesn't wait for business hours, and neither do we.

What Should You Do If Your Vehicle Is Stuck?

Before you call BP Towing, follow these steps to avoid making the situation worse:

  1. Stay calm – Panicking leads to bad decisions. You're stuck, but help is coming.

  2. Stop spinning your wheels – Spinning digs you deeper. It melts snow into ice or creates ruts in mud. Stop now.

  3. Turn on hazard lights – Make yourself visible, especially at night or in poor weather.

  4. Assess your surroundings (if safe) – Are you on a busy road? In a ditch? In a parking lot? Note any obstacles (trees, rocks, signs).

  5. Call BP Towing – Tell us your exact location. Use Google Maps "what's my location" if you're unsure. Describe the stuck situation (snow, mud, ditch, etc.).

  6. Stay inside your vehicle – On busy roads or highways, do not exit. Wait inside with your seatbelt on. On quiet residential streets or rural areas, you may step out carefully – but stay visible.

  7. Do not accept help from strangers – A well-meaning driver with a tow strap can cause thousands of dollars in damage. Wait for our professional recovery team.

Service Areas for Winch-Out in Calgary

BP Towing provides winch-out services across Calgary and a 30‑km radius, including rural roads and off‑road areas. We regularly respond to:

Downtown Calgary, Beltline, Inglewood, Bridgeland, Mission, Kensington, Hillhurst, Brentwood, Dalhousie, Varsity, Edgemont, Huntington Hills, Marlborough, Forest Lawn, Dover, Ogden, Sundance, Midnapore, Evergreen, Bridlewood, Signal Hill, Aspen Woods, Rocky Ridge, Royal Oak, Panorama Hills, Coventry Hills, and all neighbouring communities.

We also serve major roadways including Deerfoot Trail (Highway 2), Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Stoney Trail, Macleod Trail, Sarcee Trail, Highway 1 (Trans‑Canada), Highway 8, and Highway 22X, plus rural roads, job sites, fields, and off‑road areas within 30 km of Calgary.

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

How Winch-Out Recovery Works

When our technician arrives, here's what happens:

  1. Assessment – We evaluate your stuck situation: how deep, what surface, angle of pull needed, anchor points on your vehicle.

  2. Positioning – Our winch truck is positioned for the safest, most effective pull. Sometimes straight back. Sometimes at an angle. Sometimes from the side.

  3. Attachment – We attach soft straps or a winch line to proper recovery points on your vehicle. Never to bumpers, axles, or suspension components.

  4. Controlled pull – The winch pulls slowly and steadily. We may use a snatch block to change direction or increase pulling power.

  5. Freedom – Once your vehicle is on solid ground, we disconnect and you drive away. If your vehicle is damaged or won't start, we can tow you instead.

Beyond Winch-Out – Complete Roadside Assistance

Stranded? Get a free tow quote in under 60 seconds – no obligation. Call now.

  (403) 991-2265

Stop waiting!

Contact BP Towing for Winch-Out Service in Calgary

Stuck in snow, mud, ice, or a ditch? Don't spin your wheels and make it worse. Call or text BP Towing – we answer live 24 hours a day.

FAQS

Frequently Asked Questions

How fast will a winch truck arrive?

In most Calgary neighbourhoods and along major roadways, expect 25 to 45 minutes. If you’re stuck off-road or in a remote rural area, allow up to 60 minutes. We text you a live ETA once the technician is en route.

Can you winch me out of a ditch on Deerfoot or Stoney?

Yes – but safety is our priority. On high-speed roads, we coordinate with police or traffic control if needed. We position our truck to protect you and our technician.

Will winching damage my car?

Not when done professionally. We attach to manufacturer-approved recovery points or secure structural components. We do not hook to bumpers, control arms, or plastic parts. Damage-free recovery is our standard.

What if I'm stuck in a parkade or tight underground lot?

We can winch you out of most parkades, provided there is safe access and sufficient clearance (at least 1.8 metres / 6 feet). Tight corners or low ceilings may require alternative methods. Call us with details.

Can you winch out a large pickup truck or SUV?

Yes – our winches have sufficient capacity to recover full-size trucks, SUVs, and vans. For very heavy vehicles (commercial trucks, RVs), call us – we may need specialized equipment or can refer you.

What if my car is stuck but also has a mechanical problem?

We can winch you out, then tow you to a mechanic if your vehicle won’t run. One call handles both recovery and towing.

You turn the wheel. You press the gas. The engine revs, but you don’t move. Your wheels spin. You’re stuck. Maybe it’s snow. Maybe it’s ice, mud, sand, or a soft shoulder. Maybe you slid off the road on a slippery Calgary winter night. Maybe you parked on what looked like solid ground, but spring melt turned it into a mud pit.

Winch Out Service Designed for Real-Life Situations

Getting stuck is embarrassing, but it happens to almost every Calgary driver at some point. Our winters are long, our spring thaws are messy, and our roads have soft shoulders that can swallow a tire in seconds. BP Towing doesn’t judge – we just pull you out.

Common stuck situations we handle:

  • Stuck in snow – A residential street after a blizzard, an unplowed alley, or your own driveway

  • Stuck on ice – Black ice on a side street or a frozen parking lot

  • Stuck in mud – Spring or summer after heavy rain, on a rural road or job site

  • Stuck in sand or gravel – Soft shoulders on country roads or construction areas

  • Stuck in a ditch – You slid off the road on Deerfoot, Stoney, or a highway

  • Stuck in a snowbank – You misjudged the edge of the plowed road

  • Stuck in a field or off-road area – You took a wrong turn or went exploring

  • Stuck in a low-clearance situation – High-centred on a speed bump, curb, or rock

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What Makes BP Towing Different for Winch-
Out in Calgary

You might ask a friend with a truck to pull you out. But a yank with a tow strap can rip off your bumper, damage your frame, or snap the strap and send metal flying. Our professional winch-out service uses controlled techniques, proper anchors, and careful equipment placement.

Fast response times

Our winch-equipped trucks are positioned across Calgary. Most winch-out calls receive a 25- to 45-minute arrival time, depending on your location and how far off the road you are.

Certified technicians

Upfront pricing

24/7 availability

What Should You Do If Your Vehicle Is Stuck?

Before you call BP Towing, follow these steps to avoid making the situation worse:

  1. Stay calm – Panicking leads to bad decisions. You’re stuck, but help is coming.

  2. Stop spinning your wheels – Spinning digs you deeper. It melts snow into ice or creates ruts in mud. Stop now.

  3. Turn on hazard lights – Make yourself visible, especially at night or in poor weather.

  4. Assess your surroundings (if safe) – Are you on a busy road? In a ditch? In a parking lot? Note any obstacles (trees, rocks, signs).

Certified technicians

Proper equipment

We carry heavy‑duty jacks, impact wrenches, torque wrenches, wheel chocks, and gloves. Your car's factory jack might be flimsy or missing – ours are professional grade.

Safety first

Changing a tire on a highway shoulder is risky. We position our service vehicle to create a protective buffer and wear high‑visibility gear. Your safety matters as much as the tire change.

Upfront pricing

We tell you the cost before we start any work. No hidden fees, no "emergency service" surprises, no after‑hours markups.

24/7 availability

Nights, weekends, Christmas Day, Canada Day – we never close. Flat tires don't wait for business hours, and neither do we.

Tire Replacement Services – When a Spare Isn't Enough

Sometimes a spare tire isn't the answer. Maybe your car doesn't come with a spare (many new vehicles don't). Maybe you already used your spare and got another flat. Or maybe your tire is shredded beyond repair. BP Towing offers tire replacement assistance for these situations.

We can help with:

  • Seasonal tire changes – Switching from winter to all‑season tires (or vice versa) at your home or office

  • Damaged tire replacement – If you have a replacement tire available (new or used), we can mount it for you

  • Tow to a tire shop – If you need to buy a new tire, we tow you to the nearest tire store

We also serve major roadways including Deerfoot Trail (Highway 2), Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Stoney Trail, Macleod Trail, Sarcee Trail, Highway 1 (Trans‑Canada), Highway 8, and Highway 22X.

    2. Turn on hazard lights – Make yourself visible, especially at night or in bad weather.

    3. Stay inside your vehicle – On busy roads like Deerfoot or Crowchild, do not exit. Wait inside with your seatbelt on.

    4. Call BP Towing – Tell us your exact location. Use Google Maps "what's my location" if you're unsure.

    5. Locate your spare tire – If you have one, let us know where it is (trunk, under the vehicle, rear door). If you don't have a spare, tell our dispatcher – we'll plan accordingly.

Expert Assistance for Your Unexpected Vehicle Issues

Contact BP Towing for Flat Tire Change & Replacement in Calgary

Don't risk changing a tire on a dark Calgary highway or in freezing weather. Call or text BP Towing – we answer live 24 hours a day.

FAQS

Frequently Asked Questions

How fast will a technician arrive for a flat tire?

In most Calgary neighbourhoods, expect 20 to 35 minutes. During heavy snow, extreme cold, or rush hour, allow up to 45 minutes. We text you a live ETA once the technician is en route.

What if my car doesn't have a spare tire?

Many newer vehicles come with a tire repair kit instead of a spare, or no spare at all. Tell our dispatcher when you call. We can either tow you to a tire shop or, if you have a replacement tire available, we can install it for you.

Can you change a tire on a steep driveway or uneven ground?

Yes, but safety is our priority. If the ground is too unstable, we may recommend moving the vehicle to a flat surface or towing it to a safer location. We’ll explain your options.

Do you change tires for SUVs and trucks?

Our technicians carry impact wrenches and penetrating oil to handle rusted or over‑tightened lug nuts. We’ve seen it all.

Do you repair punctures, or just change the tire?

We do not perform on‑site puncture repairs (plugging a tire). That requires taking the tire off the rim, inspecting for internal damage, and proper sealing. We can change your tire to your spare or tow you to a tire shop for professional repair.

Can you help with a flat tire in an underground parkade?

Yes – provided the parkade has sufficient clearance (at least 1.8 metres / 6 feet) and safe access. Call us with your location details.

How fast will a technician arrive for a flat tire?

What if my car doesn't have a spare tire?

You're driving down Deerfoot Trail, Crowchild, or Stoney Trail. The low fuel light has been on for a while, but you thought you could make it. Then the engine sputters. You coast to the shoulder. The tank is empty. Now what?

You call BP Towing. We provide fast, reliable fuel delivery Services in Calgary – 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including nights, weekends, and holidays. One call connects you to a live dispatcher who sends a technician directly to your location with enough fuel to get you to the nearest gas station. No walking on a highway shoulder. Schedule Your Service 24/7 Emergency Service Call

Fuel Delivery Designed for Real-Life Situations

Whether you're at home in Panorama Hills, stuck in a parking lot in Marlborough, or pulled over on Stoney Trail, BP Towing comes to you. Our technicians are trained to change tires safely and efficiently on most cars, SUVs, vans, and light trucks. We handle the heavy lifting, the stubborn lug nuts, and the proper jack placement – so you don't have to.

Common flat tire situations we handle:

  • Blowout on a major roadway – Deerfoot, Glenmore, Macleod, or any Calgary street

  • Slow leak in a parking lot – You return to your car and find a flat tire

  • Pothole damage – Calgary's spring potholes are notorious for destroying tires

  • Nail or screw puncture – The most common cause of slow leaks

  • Valve stem failure – Less common but just as frustrating

  • Cold weather pressure loss – Sudden temperature drops can cause tires to go flat overnight

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What Makes BP Towing Different for Fuel
Delivery in Calgary

You might think about walking to the nearest gas station. Don't. Calgary roads are dangerous for pedestrians, especially at night or in winter. Let us bring the gas to you.

Fast response times

Our service vehicles carry fuel at all times. Most fuel delivery calls receive a 20- to 35-minute arrival time in Calgary neighbourhoods and along major routes.

Certified technicians

Every team member knows how to safely handle and pour fuel without spills, static discharge, or damage to your vehicle.

Proper fuel for your car

We carry regular gasoline (87 octane), premium gasoline (91/93 octane), and diesel. Tell our dispatcher what your car needs – we bring the right fuel.

Enough to reach a station

We deliver 5 litres of fuel. That's typically enough to drive 50–80 kilometres, depending on your vehicle. Plenty to reach the nearest gas station.

Upfront pricing

We tell you the cost before we dispatch. No hidden fees, no "emergency service" surprises, no after‑hour markups.

24/7 availability

Nights, weekends, Christmas Day, Canada Day – we never close. Empty tanks don't wait for business hours, and neither do we.

Fuel Delivery for Remote & Out‑of‑Area Locations

Stuck outside Calgary with an empty tank? BP Towing provides fuel delivery to rural roads, job sites, and less accessible areas surrounding Calgary. Whether you're on Highway 1 (Trans‑Canada), Highway 2 (QEII), Highway 22X, or a remote country road near Okotoks, Cochrane, Airdrie, or Chestermere – we're equipped to reach you.

Remote locations we serve:

  • Highways leading in and out of Calgary

  • Rural roads within 30 km of city limits

  • Job sites in industrial areas (Rocky View, Balzac, Shepard)

  • Country residential areas (Springbank, Bearspaw, Priddis)

  • Campgrounds and recreational areas near Calgary

If you're further than 30 km from Calgary, call us anyway. We may still be able to help or refer you to a local provider.

Service Areas for Fuel Delivery in Calgary

BP Towing provides fuel delivery across Calgary and a 30‑km radius. We regularly respond to:

Downtown Calgary, Beltline, Inglewood, Bridgeland, Mission, Kensington, Hillhurst, Brentwood, Dalhousie, Varsity, Edgemont, Huntington Hills, Marlborough, Forest Lawn, Dover, Ogden, Sundance, Midnapore, Evergreen, Bridlewood, Signal Hill, Aspen Woods, Rocky Ridge, Royal Oak, Panorama Hills, Coventry Hills, and all neighbouring communities.

We also serve major roadways including Deerfoot Trail (Highway 2), Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Stoney Trail, Macleod Trail, Sarcee Trail, Highway 1 (Trans‑Canada), Highway 8, Highway 22X, and Highway 2 north towards Airdrie and Edmonton.

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What to Do While Waiting for Fuel Delivery

      1. Pull over as far as possible – Onto the shoulder, a parking lot, or any safe area away from traffic.

      2. Turn on hazard lights – Make yourself visible, especially at night or in bad weather.

      3. Stay inside your vehicle – On busy roads like Deerfoot or Crowchild, do not exit. Wait inside with your seatbelt on.

      4. Call BP Towing – Tell us your exact location. Use Google Maps "what's my location" if you're unsure.

      5. Know your fuel type – Check your owner's manual or fuel cap if you're unsure. Regular (87), premium (91/93), or diesel. Tell our dispatcher.

What If Fuel Delivery Isn't Enough? We Also Tow

Sometimes fuel delivery solves the problem. Sometimes it doesn't. If your car won't start even after adding fuel (maybe there's another issue, or the fuel system needs priming), BP Towing can tow you to a mechanic. We're a full‑service towing company. One call handles everything: fuel delivery first, and if that fails, a tow to safety.

(403) 991-2265

Stop waiting!

Contact BP Towing for Fuel Delivery in Calgary

Don't walk down a dark Calgary highway or stand in freezing rain. Call or text BP Towing – we answer live 24 hours a day.

FAQS

Frequently Asked Questions

How fast will a technician arrive with fuel?

In most Calgary neighbourhoods and along major roadways, expect 20 to 35 minutes. During heavy snow, extreme cold, or rush hour, allow up to 45 minutes. We text you a live ETA once the technician is en route.

How much fuel do you deliver?

We deliver 5 litres of fuel – enough to drive approximately 50–80 kilometres, depending on your vehicle’s fuel efficiency. This is sufficient to reach the nearest gas station.

Can you deliver fuel to a highway like Deerfoot or Stoney?

Yes – we regularly deliver fuel to vehicles stranded on all Calgary highways and major roadways. Safety is our priority. We position our service vehicle to protect you and our technician.

What types of fuel do you deliver?

We provide regular gasoline (87 octane), premium gasoline (91/93 octane), and diesel. Please tell our dispatcher your fuel type when you call. We do not deliver E85, racing fuel, or propane.

What if I need diesel for a truck or heavy vehicle?

Yes – we carry diesel and can deliver to light trucks, vans, and some heavier vehicles. For semi‑trucks or large commercial vehicles, call us – we may need to arrange a larger fuel delivery or refer you to a commercial provider.

Can fuel delivery be scheduled ahead of time?

Yes – advance fuel delivery can be arranged if you know you’ll be stranded (e.g., your car is parked at home with an empty tank and you need fuel before driving). Simply call to schedule a time that works for you.

Vehicle Jump Start in Calgary | BP Towing – 24/7 Dead Battery Rescue

You turn the key. Nothing. Just a clicking sound. Or maybe the dashboard lights flicker, but the engine won't crank. Your battery is dead. Now you're stuck in your driveway, in a parking lot, or on a busy Calgary street.

You need a jump start. But you don't have jumper cables. Or you have cables but no other car. Or you're alone in an empty parking lot at midnight.

Schedule Your Service 24/7 Emergency Service Call
Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing Auto Towing Roadside Assistance Flat Tire Change or Replacement Fuel Delivery Vehicle Jump Start Winch Out Service Local Hauling Motorcycle Towing Special Vehicle Towing

Jump Start Service Designed for Real-Life Situations

Dead batteries don't give warning. One day your car starts fine. The next day – nothing. Cold Calgary winters are especially hard on batteries, but summer heat can kill them too. Whatever the reason, BP Towing doesn't ask questions – we just help.

Common dead battery situations we handle:

  • Left lights on overnight – Headlights, interior lights, or trunk lights drain the battery

  • Extreme cold weather – Calgary winters below -20°C reduce battery capacity by 50% or more

  • Old or failing battery – Most car batteries last 3–5 years. After that, they're unreliable

  • Parasitic drain – Something electrical stays on when the car is off (radio, GPS, aftermarket accessories)

  • Alternator failure – The battery isn't charging while you drive. A jump start gets you going, but you'll need a tow soon

  • Infrequent driving – If you drive rarely, the battery drains naturally over time

  • Door left ajar – Dome lights can drain a battery overnight

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What Makes BP Towing Different for Jump
Starts in Calgary

You might ask a stranger for a jump start. But finding someone with cables who knows how to use them safely isn't guaranteed. Wrong connections can fry your car's computer or cause an explosion. Let our professionals handle it.

Fast response times

Our service vehicles carry portable jump packs at all times. Most jump start calls receive a 20- to 35-minute arrival time in Calgary neighbourhoods and along major routes.

Certified technicians

Every team member knows proper jump start procedure: positive to positive, negative to ground, not to the dead battery. No reverse polarity. No sparks near battery fumes.

Portable jump packs

We don't need a second vehicle. Our professional-grade booster packs have enough power to start most cars, SUVs, and light trucks – even in cold weather.

Safe for modern vehicles

Newer cars have sensitive electronics. Our jump packs have surge protection and regulated voltage. No risk of frying your ECU, infotainment system, or sensors.

Upfront pricing

We tell you the cost before we dispatch. No hidden fees, no "emergency service" surprises, no after‑hour markups.

24/7 availability

Nights, weekends, Christmas Day, Canada Day – we never close. Dead batteries don't wait for business hours, and neither do we.

What If a Jump Start Isn't Enough? We Also Tow

Sometimes a jump start gets you running. Sometimes it doesn't. If your battery is completely dead (frozen, damaged, or zero volts), or if your alternator has failed, your car may die again minutes after the jump. BP Towing is a full‑service towing company. One call handles everything:

  • First, we attempt a jump start

  • If that works, you drive away (but we recommend going straight to a mechanic or battery store)

  • If that fails, we tow you to your preferred location

No need to call a second company.

Service Areas for Jump Start in Calgary

BP Towing provides jump start services across Calgary and a 30‑km radius. We regularly respond to:

Downtown Calgary, Beltline, Inglewood, Bridgeland, Mission, Kensington, Hillhurst, Brentwood, Dalhousie, Varsity, Edgemont, Huntington Hills, Marlborough, Forest Lawn, Dover, Ogden, Sundance, Midnapore, Evergreen, Bridlewood, Signal Hill, Aspen Woods, Rocky Ridge, Royal Oak, Panorama Hills, Coventry Hills, and all neighbouring communities.

We also serve major roadways including Deerfoot Trail (Highway 2), Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Stoney Trail, Macleod Trail, Sarcee Trail, Highway 1 (Trans‑Canada), Highway 8, and Highway 22X, plus parking lots, parkades, and residential driveways.

Call Now | (403) 991-2265

What to Do While Waiting for a Jump Start

        1. Turn off all electrical loads – Lights, radio, AC, heated seats, phone chargers. This preserves any remaining battery power.

        2. Try turning the key again – Sometimes a second attempt works (but probably not).

        3. Stay inside your vehicle – On busy roads, wait inside with your seatbelt on and doors locked.

        4. Call BP Towing – Tell us your exact location. Use Google Maps "what's my location" if you're unsure.

        5. Pop the hood if it's safe – If you're in a safe location (your driveway, a parking lot), open the hood so our technician can work faster. On a highway shoulder, wait inside – we'll handle it.

Beyond Jump Starts – Complete Roadside Assistance

Stranded? Get a free tow quote in under 60 seconds – no obligation. Call now.

  (403) 991-2265

Stop waiting!

Contact BP Towing for a Vehicle Jump Start in Calgary

Don't stand in freezing rain or a dark parking lot with a dead car. Call or text BP Towing – we answer live 24 hours a day.

FAQS

Frequently Asked Questions

How fast will a technician arrive for a jump start?

In most Calgary neighbourhoods, expect 20 to 35 minutes. During heavy snow, extreme cold (below -25°C), or rush hour, allow up to 45 minutes. We text you a live ETA once the technician is en route.

Do I need another car for a jump start?

No – we use portable jump packs. No second vehicle is required. We come to you with everything needed.

Can you jump start my car in an underground parkade?

Yes – provided the parkade has sufficient clearance (at least 1.8 metres / 6 feet) and safe access. Our portable jump packs work anywhere.

What if my battery is frozen?

In extreme cold, batteries can freeze. Do not attempt to jump start a frozen battery – it can explode. Our technician will check for freezing. If frozen, we recommend a tow to a warm shop for replacement.

Can you jump start a hybrid or electric vehicle?

Yes – but with important differences. Hybrids and EVs have two batteries: a small 12V battery for electronics (which can die) and a high‑voltage traction battery (which rarely dies). We can jump start the 12V battery to get the car ready to drive. Call us with your vehicle type.

Do you jump start motorcycles, RVs, or boats?

We jump start most motorcycles (12V systems). For large RVs or boats, call us – we may need specialized equipment or can refer you.

A dead battery. A flat tire. Keys locked inside your car. An empty fuel tank on a cold Calgary night. These things never happen at a good time. That’s where BP Towing comes in. Battery boosts / jump‑starts

Flat tire and no spare? Or a spare but no tools? We handle both. We'll swap in your spare or use our own equipment to get you rolling.

Vehicle lockout assistance

Keys locked inside? We use non‑damaging entry tools to get you back in without breaking windows or scratching paint.

Winching & recovery

Stuck in snow, mud, a ditch, or even a icy cul‑de‑sac? Our winch can pull you out safely.

Light mechanical support

Minor issues like a loose belt, disconnected hose, or something simple? We'll take a look and sometimes fix it on the spot.

What Makes BP Towing Different for Roadside Assistance in Calgary

Fast response times – Our service vehicles are positioned across the city. When you call, we dispatch the nearest available technician. Most calls receive a 20‑ to 35‑minute arrival time in normal conditions.

Upfront pricing – We tell you the cost before we start any work. No hidden fees, no “service call” surprises, no after‑hours markups. Just honest, transparent rates.

24/7 availability – Nights, weekends, Christmas Day, Canada Day – we never close. Emergencies don’t take holidays, and neither do we.

Wide vehicle support – We assist cars, SUVs, vans, crossovers, light trucks, and even motorcycles. If you drive it, we can probably help.

content.raw:
Contact Us

Stop waiting!

Get Towing Help Now!

Don’t sit stranded when help is just one call away. BP Towing Service is available 24/7 to provide fast, professional towing and roadside assistance anywhere in Calgary and surrounding areas. Whether you need a vehicle tow, a battery boost, a tire change, or emergency roadside help — we’re ready to respond.

Booking is quick, simple, and stress-free. Contact us now and let our team get you back on the road safely.

Serving Calgary, Airdrie, Chestermere, and nearby communities — day and night.

  • Or Call Us! | 14039912265

Address

324 41 Ave NE, UNIT B, Calgary, AB T2E 2N3

Phone

(403) 991-2265

Email

info@bptowingservice.ca

Car Towing Services in Calgary

WHAT WE OFFER

Wherever You’re Stuck, We’re Already on the Way

Auto Towing

Professional vehicle towing with modern flatbed trucks and wreckers. We handle cars, trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles across Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, and Okotoks. Safe transport, trained operators, and transparent pricing for every tow.

Flat Tire Change or Replacement

On-site mobile tire assistance anywhere in Calgary. We handle flat tire changes, patch repairs, and full replacements at your home, work, or roadside. Professional technicians arrive with all necessary tools. Fast, safe, and convenient.

Battery Boost & Jump Start

24/7 jump starts – even in extreme cold. Dead battery? We'll get you running in minutes. BP Towing Service provides rapid-response battery boosting across Calgary with heavy-duty equipment for cars, trucks, and SUVs. Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week—even during harsh winter conditions.

Cash for Junk Cars & Scrap Vehicles

Top cash paid – free removal. Turn your unwanted vehicle into instant cash. We buy junk cars, scrap vehicles, and damaged cars in any condition—running or not. Competitive offers, free towing, and hassle-free removal across Calgary. No hidden fees. No paperwork stress.

Emergency Fuel Delivery

Gas, diesel & premium – delivered to you. Ran out of gas? We bring fuel to your location. BP Towing Service delivers regular, premium, and diesel fuel directly to stranded vehicles across Calgary and surrounding areas. Fast response, clean delivery, and no need for a tow.

Winch-Out & Vehicle Recovery

Professional recovery from snow, mud & ditches. Stuck off-road or in a snowbank? Our recovery specialists use advanced winching equipment to safely extract vehicles from snow, mud, ice, and ditches—without causing damage. Reliable recovery for cars, trucks, and SUVs across Calgary.

Roadside Assistance

24/7 emergency roadside support across Calgary. Our mobile units arrive within 30 minutes for flat tire changes, battery jumps, fuel delivery, lockout assistance, and minor repairs. Professional equipment. Fast response. Reliable service when you need it most.

Local Hauling

Small-scale transport solutions for trailers, boats, ATVs, snowmobiles, and equipment. Reliable local hauling for homeowners, contractors, and businesses across Calgary. Proper securing equipment. Flexible scheduling. Transparent pricing.

Motorcycle Towing

Specialized motorcycle transport with damage-free guarantee. Our flatbed trucks feature motorcycle-specific wheel chocks and soft straps for secure transport. We handle cruisers, sport bikes, touring models, dirt bikes, and scooters across Calgary.

What We Done So Far

Our Work

Testimonials

Customer Reviews

[trustindex no-registration=google]

Expert Assistance for Your Unexpected Vehicle Issues

Stranded? Get a free tow quote in under 60 seconds – no obligation. Call now.

(403) 991-2265

Stop waiting!

Get Towing Help Now!

Don’t sit stranded when help is just one call away. BP Towing Service is available 24/7 to provide fast, professional towing and roadside assistance anywhere in Calgary and surrounding areas. Whether you need a vehicle tow, a battery boost, a tire change, or emergency roadside help — we’re ready to respond.

Booking is quick, simple, and stress-free. Contact us now and let our team get you back on the road safely.

Serving Calgary, Airdrie, Chestermere, and nearby communities — day and night.

content.raw:
About BP Towing | Calgary's Trusted Towing & Roadside Assistance

Vehicle problems never happen at a good time. That's why BP Towing exists – to deliver fast, dependable, and professional towing and roadside assistance throughout Calgary and nearby communities, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Schedule Your Service 24/7 Emergency Service Call

Need a Tow? Get Help Now

Who We Are

BP Towing is a locally owned and operated towing company serving Calgary, Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks, and surrounding areas. We're not a call center or a national chain. When you call BP Towing, you reach a real person who dispatches a real driver – someone who knows Calgary roads, understands local weather challenges, and treats your vehicle with respect.

WHAT WE OFFER

What We Do

Auto Towing

Professional vehicle towing with modern flatbed trucks and wreckers. We handle cars, trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles across Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere, and Okotoks. Safe transport, trained operators, and transparent pricing for every tow.

Flat Tire Change or Replacement

On-site mobile tire assistance anywhere in Calgary. We handle flat tire changes, patch repairs, and full replacements at your home, work, or roadside. Professional technicians arrive with all necessary tools. Fast, safe, and convenient.

Battery Boost & Jump Start

24/7 jump starts – even in extreme cold. Dead battery? We'll get you running in minutes. BP Towing Service provides rapid-response battery boosting across Calgary with heavy-duty equipment for cars, trucks, and SUVs. Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week—even during harsh winter conditions.

Cash for Junk Cars & Scrap Vehicles

Top cash paid – free removal. Turn your unwanted vehicle into instant cash. We buy junk cars, scrap vehicles, and damaged cars in any condition—running or not. Competitive offers, free towing, and hassle-free removal across Calgary. No hidden fees. No paperwork stress.

Emergency Fuel Delivery

Gas, diesel & premium – delivered to you. Ran out of gas? We bring fuel to your location. BP Towing Service delivers regular, premium, and diesel fuel directly to stranded vehicles across Calgary and surrounding areas. Fast response, clean delivery, and no need for a tow.

Winch-Out & Vehicle Recovery

Professional recovery from snow, mud & ditches. Stuck off-road or in a snowbank? Our recovery specialists use advanced winching equipment to safely extract vehicles from snow, mud, ice, and ditches—without causing damage. Reliable recovery for cars, trucks, and SUVs across Calgary.

Roadside Assistance

24/7 emergency roadside support across Calgary. Our mobile units arrive within 30 minutes for flat tire changes, battery jumps, fuel delivery, lockout assistance, and minor repairs. Professional equipment. Fast response. Reliable service when you need it most.

Local Hauling

Small-scale transport solutions for trailers, boats, ATVs, snowmobiles, and equipment. Reliable local hauling for homeowners, contractors, and businesses across Calgary. Proper securing equipment. Flexible scheduling. Transparent pricing.

Motorcycle Towing

Specialized motorcycle transport with damage-free guarantee. Our flatbed trucks feature motorcycle-specific wheel chocks and soft straps for secure transport. We handle cruisers, sport bikes, touring models, dirt bikes, and scooters across Calgary.

We Tow

All Types of Vehicles

What We Done So Far

Our Work

Testimonials

Customer Reviews

Stop waiting!

Get Towing Help Now!

Don’t sit stranded when help is just one call away. BP Towing Service is available 24/7 to provide fast, professional towing and roadside assistance anywhere in Calgary and surrounding areas. Whether you need a vehicle tow, a battery boost, a tire change, or emergency roadside help — we’re ready to respond.

Booking is quick, simple, and stress-free. Contact us now and let our team get you back on the road safely.

Serving Calgary, Airdrie, Chestermere, and nearby communities — day and night.
